description: pixel art landscape, vast grey stone rivers of quartzite boulders on the slopes of old low mountains, no trees on the scree, dark fir forests at the edges, a lone griffin circling high above, a pale cold sky with racing clouds, wide panorama for a dim background behind text, low contrast, muted palette of stone greys, fir greens and pale blues, no text, no border, no people, no animals in front
